names.name: Dunkaroos Cinnamon Graham Cookie Vanilla Frosting 12 Count

product.ingredients: Vanilla Frosting with Rainbow Chips: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water, Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Nonfat Dry Milk, Whey Powder, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Color (yellow 6 lake, blue 1 lake, yellow 5 lake, blue 2 lake, red 40 lake, yellow 5, yellow 6), Soy Lecithin, Maltodextrin, Citric Acid. Freshness preserved by Potassium Sorbate. Cinnamon Graham Cookies: Graham Flour, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Palm Oil, Cinnamon, Invert Sugar, Molasses, Honey, Salt, Sodium Bicarbonate.
